submission.justification: This recommendation is CONDITIONAL. It is not final. Crystal-K2 gives the best simulated energy resolution at 662 keV by a wide margin: about 2.9-3.0% FWHM at 4.5-5 cm, compared with about 4.3% for K1 and 8.5% for K3 at 5 cm. These results match the 2025 summary. A thickness scan over 2-10 cm found the best resolution near 4.5-5 cm for all three crystals. For K2, 4.5 cm gave 2.93% and two runs at 5 cm gave 2.94% and 3.05%, so run-to-run scatter is about ±0.1%. Resolution gets worse at both ends of the range: 3.18% at 2 cm and 3.96% at 10 cm. I chose 5 cm because it is in the flat optimum and matches the nominal design. IMPORTANT: none of the project documents or tools gives any intrinsic-background data for any candidate, so I could not check the hard 0.5 counts/kg/day (100-3000 keV) limit for K2, K1 or K3. There is also a specific risk: high-light-yield, fast inorganic scintillators like K2 often contain intrinsic radioactive isotopes that can put them far over a low-background budget. Before Q2 procurement, the collaboration must get vendor assay data or measure a sample's intrinsic background. If K2 is over the budget, the next choice by resolution is K1 at about 5 cm (~4.3%), but it needs the same background check, followed by K3 (~8.5%). Whichever crystal is used must meet the background limit.

requirements.requirement: Goal: best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Simulated at 5 cm: K2 2.94/3.05%, K1 4.28%, K3 8.48%. K2 thickness scan: 2 cm 3.18%, 3.5 cm 3.20%, 4.5 cm 2.93%, 6 cm 3.07%, 7 cm 3.18%, 10 cm 3.96%. K2 at about 5 cm gives the best resolution among the candidates, assuming the background check passes.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md

requirements.evidence: None of the documents (specs, meeting notes, simulation summary, shielding, DAQ, schedule) gives intrinsic background for any crystal, and the simulation tool only reports resolution. This must be checked with vendor assay data or a sample measurement before procurement. High-light-yield fast scintillators are known to carry intrinsic radioactivity, so this is a real risk for K2.
5 cm is recommended, within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended crystal and thickness
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K2 at 5 cm, conditional on passing the background check.
